subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A supermarket tested labels showing the estimated carbon footprint of some foods.”?
options: Customers had to weigh containers and write labels.
Protecting nature sometimes means thinking beyond human borders.
The labels helped shoppers compare products beyond price.
Many said it helped them feel less nervous.
